title: Possible Azure storage account key in source
description: A committed Azure storage account key was found in a configuration or source file. Anyone with repository access can use it to reach the service it names until it is rotated. Shape-only: the match does not prove the value is live.
remediation: Rotate the credential in the provider console, check its access logs, and load the replacement from a secret manager at run time.
limitation: Shape-only: matches the documented syntax of this configuration form. It cannot prove the value is a live credential.
